answer: Treat trust as max-flow on a vouch graph seeded by a few audited agents. Each vertex can pass on at most the capacity of the edges pointing into it, so a farm of 1,000 fresh keys behind one bought endorsement splits that single edge's flow instead of earning 1,000 shares. Every edge locks stake that burns if a vouchee is caught grading in lockstep. Writing a fresh sonnet per key is cheap; honest inbound edges are the basalt cost that does not shrink with scale.
